messages:
Vivian: quick sync — sketching an adaptive headroom delegation approach for dedicated GPU pools. two-layer idea: predictive tenant warmup (predictive model + lookahead) + reactive emergency burst. trying to avoid overprovisioning while keeping latency SLOs. paste of a tiny config sketch below, feedback pls.

Vivian: ```policy:
  headroom_pct: 0.12
  lookahead_sec: 90
  smoothing_window_ms: 700
  burst_credit_pool: 'global'
  prewarm_action: 'soft-reserve'
```

Sam: hmm i worry about double-counting burst credits when tenants have reserved vs shared burst. how do we reconcile billing vs controller accounting? :thinking:

Leo: agree with Sam. can we separate "observability credits" from "admission credits"? keep billing tied to reserved capacity and let shared credits be ephemeral. smoothing_window looks small — 700ms might chase noise.

Rahul: eviction interplay — if prewarm_action is soft-reserve we still might evict during node pressure. need a preemption-shield for in-flight KV cache fills. otherwise warmup wasted.

Marta: from product side, we need a simple API: `reserve(headroom_ms, opts)` and a `release` path. also rollback plan: canary on 10% tenants with fail-open to baseline.

Vivian: good points. proposal: 1) keep billing anchored to explicit reserved tokens; 2) ephemeral shared pool is not billed but meter meters usage for charge-back; 3) implement preemption-shield by tagging warmup leases with `warmup=true` and short-term priority bump (grace window).

Sam: what metrics would we expose to verify savings? token/sec cost delta, 95th/99th gen latency, warmup hit rate, wasted-warmup-seconds.

Vivian: exactly — add `warmup_waste_seconds` and `headroom_efficiency = (served_from_warmup / total_warmup)`. run A/B for 2 weeks.

Leo: simulation note: use our trace-replay infra with bursty arrivals + multi-tenant mix. include preemptible node churn. run with smoothing_window 500/1000/2000ms to find sweet spot.

orch-bot: simulation-job 54321 started (trace: prod-weekend-2025-11, seed: 42). ETA ~12h. :rocket:

Rahul: also add a safety fallback: if global shared pool < threshold, degrade to predictive-only and refuse new soft-reserves. that avoids cascade.

Marta: thumbs up for gradual rollout. can engineering own the feature flag and docs? i'll coordinate UXR prompts for customer-facing messaging. :thumbsup:

Vivian: thanks all — i'll open a small RFC with config presets, telemetry plan, and rollout checklist. will ping when RFC lands.
